parsed.text: Panel p0 and panel p1 current views (represented time 12–13) show uniform 4×4 location distributions for both red and blue at all four nodes. Candidate (conditional) records differ only at node n2: for command k0 both panels place blue mass primarily on the four cells in columns 2–3 of rows 0–1 and red mass on the four cells in columns 0–1 of rows 0–1; for command k1 both panels concentrate blue at cell (0,2) and red at (0,1); for command k2 both panels present uniform distributions at n2. Current records are inherited or copied (not new event claims); candidate records are conditional estimates (not executed events). The text summarizes distributional differences across commands; numeric peak cells for every supplied distribution are listed in the propositions.
